home.aboutText1: I am a visual artist and tattoo artist, and my work moves between drawing, painting, and ceramics. Through my creations, I explore the relationship between the body, nature, and human sensitivity. My work is strongly influenced by ecofeminism, the connection with the environment, and the emotions that permeate us. As a tattoo artist, I specialize in delicate designs with an organic and fluid aesthetic, often inspired by natural elements such as flowers and plants.
home.aboutText2: For many of my clients, getting a tattoo is a symbolic act, a gesture of transformation or personal resignification, and I love being able to accompany them in this process. In my painting and ceramic work, I also explore the connection between the human and the natural, creating images and objects that evoke strength, tenderness, and harmony with the world around us. Each piece I create, whether a tattoo, a painting, or a ceramic piece, is a dialogue between my artistic universe and those who inhabit it.
home.aboutArtistTitle: Searching for something of my style?
home.aboutArtistSubtitle: I'm Niki Peppers, a multidisciplinary artist passionate about transforming ideas into art. My work spans tattoos, ceramics, murals, and paintings, each piece crafted with dedication and creativity. From intricate body art to handcrafted ceramic pieces and large-scale murals, I bring stories to life through various mediums. Every creation is a unique expression of art that connects with the soul.

orders.faq1A: For tattoos, I recommend booking 2-4 weeks in advance. Ceramic pieces take 4-6 weeks, and murals vary depending on scope and size.
orders.faq2A: Yes, a 30% deposit is required to secure your booking. This goes toward the final cost and is non-refundable.

orders.faq4A: Please provide at least 48 hours notice for cancellations. The deposit can be transferred to a future booking within 6 months.

biography.title: Biography
biography.description: My journey through art and creativity
biography.bio1: Since she was little, she attended several workshops where she began to develop her style, starting with portraiture.
biography.bio2: At 19, she began pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Visual Arts at the National University of the Arts (Buenos Aires), ultimately choosing to major in Painting. Her time at the university was significant, as she was able to experiment with other disciplines such as sculpture and installation.
biography.bio3: She also attended workshops with renowned artists, such as Adriana Cerviño's ceramics workshop and painting workshops with Lean Frizzera and Ricardo Celma.
biography.bio4: At the same time, she began tattooing as a self-taught artist at the age of 19 and, since 2019, has had her own tattoo studio in Buenos Aires.
